statement: Every component of the origin fibre of a proper analytic cap with smooth fourfold total space flat over r and a holomorphic fixed-bidisc map is a vertical threefold; no two-dimensional origin component is possible
depends_on: B.4.24; finite local analytic projection; normal-surface finite-flat trace

notes: Root and boundary_d passed the full proof. Any local fibre-dimension2 point produces a finite multisection of positive degree; explicit cyclic-root character norms extend its traces on both known axes, contradicting the dF ghost class.
